mentions.name: Rauversion
mentions.description: Rauversion is an open-source platform for independent music communities that combines music publishing, events, and marketplace tools in one place. Artists can upload tracks, albums, and playlists with metadata and audio processing (waveforms, analysis), plus embeddable players with chunk-range loading to save bandwidth. It also provides event ticketing with QR validation and Stripe payouts, streaming integrations (Twitch, Zoom, etc.), a magazine system for publishing articles, and a marketplace for selling music (digital or physical), gear, merch, and services. It aims to give underground scenes self-hosted infrastructure for releasing music, organizing events, and sustaining their communities.
mentions.problem: Underground music scenes lack a single, self-hosted platform for releasing music, organizing events, and sustaining their communities.
mentions.audience: Independent music communities, artists, and underground scenes
